_comment: Working demos that run on the same simulated data as a subdomain. Read by apps/explorer-web/lib/demos.ts and viewer/build_dataset.py.

refinery_operations.title: Factory to Field
refinery_operations.blurb: A crude-unit pump alarm traced through SAP PM, the PI historian and the pump maker's records to a bearing lot approved with its qualification test waived. Same simulated refineries as this page's data.

upstream_artificial_lift.title: Factory to Field
upstream_artificial_lift.blurb: An ESP motor-temperature alarm in well A-07 traced to a seal elastomer lot: Kaplan-Meier run life 290 days against 780 for earlier builds. Same simulated field as this page's data.

predictive_maintenance.title: Factory to Field
predictive_maintenance.blurb: Vibration alarms, stuck sensors and position-versus-unit history on API 610 pumps, investigated by agents that cite every number and cannot write to control systems.
